property_summary: For any call to transfer, the target contract caddress must receive exactly one transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v) call per recipient; the buggy version instead calls each recipient address _tos[i] (never caddress), so a recording helper at caddress records zero transferFrom invocations in the mutant.
change_summary: Swap the call arguments so caddress is passed as the token recipient and _tos[i] is used as the target contract address.
